LESSON: SELF- EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Self- expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self- expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: what is the time? At what time....?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen attentively to a presentation on telling time using the 12-hour clock,

2. collaborate with peers to answer questions from the presentation,

3. describe the main idea in a text related to the school timetable,

4. pick out vocabulary from the text and display on flashcards,

5. make an oral presentation using simple sentences on time for example,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen attentively to a presentation on telling time using the 12-hour clock,
2. collaborate with peers to answer questions from the presentation,
3. describe the main idea in a text related to the school timetable,
4. pick out vocabulary from the text and display on flashcards,
5. make an oral presentation using simple sentences on time for example,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self- expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem solving: These are promoted as the learner analyses concepts when observing various clock

faces and tells different times shown.

• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner shows defining personal skills set when making an oral presentation using

simple sentences on time.

Values:
Respect: This is promoted as the learner accommodates diverse opinions when collaborating with peers to answer questions

from the presentation.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as learners work together to accomplish tasks and achieve group goals.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of time to their learning of time as covered in Mathematics.
